market_view: Calm regime: VIX 14.6 and falling, 10-year yield 4.68%, dollar flat near 100. Q2 earnings season continues; a surprise inflation print is in the headlines.

oil_gas.catalyst: none: the COP Q2 call ("Record Permian output and $4.2B free cash flow", Yahoo) is about COP, not the leader XOM
oil_gas.reasoning: No XOM-specific catalyst. WTI is up 10.7% in 5 days and XOM up 5.4%, so that is priced in. The XOM valuation article is commentary, not news.

gold_miners.catalyst: none: the Headwater earn-in (Benzinga) is minor; NEM is up 24% in a month and the Yahoo piece cites lower production and rising costs
gold_miners.reasoning: NEM is up 13% in 5 days with no guidance news. Gold is 4467, below its 200-day average. The Barrick Q2 beat is already known.

chips.catalyst: none: "Nvidia and Broadcom Deepen AI Financing Push - But Wolfe Sees Long-Term Risks" (Yahoo) cuts both ways
chips.reasoning: NVDA is up 3% on the day and 5.5% over 20 days. The headlines are AI financing and the Cerebras miss, with nothing NVDA-specific or one-sided.

pharma.catalyst: none: the OPKO mazdutide royalty notes (Yahoo) are a financing for a third party, not an LLY catalyst
pharma.reasoning: LLY is up 21% in 60 days and sits 1% below its high. The ABBV upgrade does not carry over to LLY. No LLY filing or trial news.

copper_uranium.catalyst: none: "FCX's Q2 Volumes Fall Y/Y on Lower Operating Rates" (Yahoo): earnings beat but copper volumes fell 30%, so mixed
copper_uranium.reasoning: Earnings are out and mixed; FCX is up 13.5% in 20 days with copper near its high. No guidance raise or Section 232 news.

would_change_my_mind: A leader-specific one-sided event: an XOM or NEM guidance raise, an NVDA export-rule change or large order, an LLY filing or approval, or an FCX guidance raise or supply outage.

handoff.what_changed: Oil rebounded: WTI 83.3, +10.7% in 5 days, XOM +5.4%. Gold is 4467 (+3.8% in 5 days) and NEM +13%. COP reported a record Permian quarter and FCX beat but with volumes down 30%. AI financing news is heavy (AMD $5B bond, Nvidia and Broadcom debt) and Cerebras plunged on earnings.

oil_gas.why: No XOM-specific catalyst; the oil rebound is already priced.

gold_miners.why: NEM rallied 24% in a month and no guidance news is out.

chips.why: AI financing headlines are two-sided and NVDA has no specific catalyst.

pharma.why: No LLY catalyst; the stock is near its high after a 21% 60-day gain.

copper_uranium.why: FCX earnings were mixed with volumes down 30%; no guidance raise.
